Bill paid once lifecycle (recorded on the server's day, funded as an essential or overdue item in the first plan whose window reaches its due date, marked paid, or recorded as an expense when already paid)
Payday funding tiers 0 to 5 in strict order
Living money accounting and re-anchoring from the daily account balance
Accuracy layers that keep the bot's numbers correct
Front go-live on 2026-11-01 (secrets set, prune fixed, start, rendered env checked, one-shot submit test, test proposal #2)
M3 approval flow (front asks, control posts, the owner taps, the applier would apply)
Own-record merge rules (same bank, coverage gate, merged duplicates, correction, lepas, cash never merges)
Vault zone on internal net-vault: Hermes gateway, vault-tools MCP server and squid-vault
Plan and pot computed from the pre-salary state (usulan #9 and #10)
restic backup lifecycle through backup.sh (daily backup, monthly integrity check, weekly retention)
M3 change approval chain (front submit, change-proposals, proposals-inbox, control decides on the owner's tap, applier later)
Payday cycle on the 1st (status_gajian, sisa_uang_harian, generate_payday_plan, periksa_data, recording tools, saldo_rekening)
Per-zone squid proxies are the only members of the egress network
Statement import tool flow
Marking payday-plan payments as done by kind (cards, debt installments, other transfers, one-off bills), read back by status_gajian
Front stack up on 2026-11-01 04:34 UTC: front and change-proposals containers, first squid-front traffic
Weekly prune removes the idle ingest-gmail image and the next daily ingest rebuilds it
Morning statement ingest (06:00 WIB) followed by the Notion snapshot (06:30 WIB) from vault-tools through squid-vault
Deploy 2 on the live ledger (2026-11-01): pre-deploy2 backup, schema user_version 14 with the new one_off_bills table, biaya_admin_* thresholds, vault-tools image rebuilt 10:26 WIB
Daily money computation (top-up plus leftover, anchored by the daily-account reading)
Deploy 2 delivered across the progress log, the payday spec and SOUL (admin fees, bills paid once, instalment undo, grace period, data fix, schema 14)
Payday progress records (schema v13 tables and the tools that write and read them)
Pot planning flow (schedule, pattern, simulator, plan, roadmap)
Context compression machinery
Gateway SIGTERM shutdown and revive cycle
Change-proposal path: the front gateway holds CHANGE_PROPOSALS_MCP_TOKEN and reaches change-proposals directly (NO_PROXY), which shares the proposals-inbox with control
Numbers computed by code, never by the model
Full card and account numbers kept out of the bot (tokens, alias plus last 4 digits)

Deploy 2: admin fees and one-off bills shipped (usulan #4 and #6)
Daily Gmail statement ingest path (pa-ingest, ingest-gmail run, squid-vault, Google APIs)
Autodebit debts paid manually before the debit date (usulan #5, #7, #8)
restic check and retention locked out at 04:00 on 2026-11-01

Statement ingest: ingest-gmail and pa-uploads fill /ingest, PDFs become statements and mutation files
